notes.title: 🚂 Update – New Missions and Features! 🚂
notes.notes:
I am excited to share a major update for Train World Driver that brings more realism, depth, and variety to your driving experience:

🔧 What’s New:
🛤  Missions with Reverse Movement – Take on new challenges that require driving your train in reverse.

🎮 Updated Controls – Reverse driving is now fully supported and automatically enabled during relevant missions.

🎥 Smart Camera – The camera now switches automatically when driving in reverse for better visibility.

🚋 Coupling and Uncoupling Missions – Engage in hands-on operations that simulate real train logistics.

⚠️ Enhanced Driver Panel – A revamped interface provides clearer warnings for upcoming stops and speed changes, making it easier to stay on schedule and under control.

🚇 Tunnel Interiors – Explore fully modeled tunnel environments from the cab view.

🛠 Model Updates – Refreshed visuals for tunnels, electrification systems, and numerous locomotives.

🎯 3 New Missions – Try out scenarios that showcase the new reverse driving and coupling mechanics.

Thank you for being a part of the Train World Driver journey. Let’s keep building something amazing together!

notes.title: The demo version is available!
notes.notes:
🚆 Train World Driver – Demo is available! 
Big milestone alert! The Train World Driver Demo is now available on Steam! Step into the driver's seat, take control of legendary locomotives and master the rails across different eras. Are you ready to take on the challenge?

💡 Recent Updates & Fixes 
We've already rolled out some updates and fixes! If you encounter any issues, please let me know—I truly appreciate your feedback! 🙌

🛤️  What's Next? 
There are big plans for both immediate and long-term development, including:


 🏆 Leaderboards– Compete and prove you're the best driver!
 🎮 Controller Support – Full gamepad compatibility is on the way!
 👥 Local Multiplayer – Exploring ways to bring co-op/train races!
 🏅 Achievements – Unlock rewards for your driving skills!
 ⏳ Dynamic Time Scale – Train-based & automatic time speed options!


💬 Join the Discussion! 
Your feedback is invaluable! Share your experience in the Discussions section or hop into our Discord to chat with the community. I’d love to hear what you think! 💙

🚂 Play the Demo & Wishlist Now! 

See you on the rails, Driver! 🚆
